card.title: 41st INFANTRY REGIMENT
card.text: Deployment: Develop DEATH FROM ABOVE, UNITY IS STRENGTH or WE CAN DO IT!
card.flavorText: The 41st Infantry Regiment was first activated in June 1917 at Fort Snelling, Minnesota. Though readied for deployment to France during World War I, the regiment never saw combat before the Armistice. After a series of reorganizations during the interwar years, it returned to active status before WWII. In 1942, the regiment was assigned to the 2nd Armored Division, becoming one of the first mechanized infantry units of its kind. It landed in North Africa during Operation Torch, then advanced through Sicily. From June 1944, it was involved in the Battle of Normandy, and spearheaded armored thrusts deep into Nazi-occupied Europe. The 41st fought in some of the toughest campaigns, including the Ardennes and the crossing of the Rhine into Germany. Throughout the war, its soldiers rode into battle in half-tracks, alongside tanks, supporting rapid advances and urban assaults. Their effectiveness in combined arms warfare earned them a reputation for discipline and aggression. After WWII, the regiment continued to serve in major conflicts including Desert Storm and operations in Iraq and Afghanistan.
